question: Show top 5 customers by total order amount
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total revenue for each product category?
sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS category_revenue FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY category_revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

question: How many orders were placed by customers in each city?
sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 20;

question: List products that have low stock (less than 50 units)
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.stock, cat.name AS category FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE p.stock < 50 ORDER BY p.stock ASC LIMIT 20;
